ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circular track, and the black dot represents the object, located at the right edge of the circle. Five candidate arrows are drawn at the black dot: A points to the lower left, B points directly left, C points to the upper left, D points upward, and E points rightward. Reasoning: When the object undergoes uniform circular motion, the direction of the resultant force is the centripetal direction, that is, from the object's current position toward the center of the circle. Since the black dot is on the right side of the circle, the center of the circle is directly to the left of the black dot, so the direction of the resultant force corresponds to the directly leftward arrow B.

raw_record.question_text: In the accompanying figure, what labeled arrow shows the direction of the net force acting on the object at the instant shown?

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a circle with the object shown by a black dot on the right edge of the circular path. Note the candidate force arrows from the dot: A down-left, B directly left, C up-left, D upward, and E rightward. Read the question as asking for the direction of the net force on an object in uniform circular motion at that instant. Use the rule that in uniform circular motion the net force is centripetal, always directed from the object toward the center of the circle. Since the center of the circle is directly to the left of the dot, choose the leftward arrow labeled B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个圆形轨道，黑点表示物体，位于圆的右侧边缘。黑点处画出五个候选箭头：A 指向左下，B 指向正左，C 指向左上，D 指向上方，E 指向右方。推理：物体做匀速圆周运动时，合力方向是向心方向，也就是从物体当前位置指向圆心。由于黑点在圆的右侧，圆心在黑点的正左方，因此合力方向对应正左的箭头 B。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the dot is on the right side of a circular track, with several possible arrows drawn from the dot, and the curved arrow on the circle indicates circular motion. Use the motion information to infer that the instantaneous velocity is tangent to the circle, not radial. The net force must point in the direction of acceleration, and for motion along a curved path at constant speed the acceleration is perpendicular to the tangent velocity and toward the inside of the curve. At the rightmost point of the circle, the inward normal direction is horizontally left, matching arrow B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中，一个黑点位于圆形轨道的右侧边缘附近，从黑点发出多根带标签的箭头：A 指向左下，B 指向水平向左，C 指向左上，D 指向上方，E 指向右方。圆内左侧有一条弯曲箭头，表示物体沿圆周运动。根据匀速圆周运动，瞬时速度沿切线方向，而净力方向与加速度方向一致，指向圆心，即向心方向。黑点在圆的最右侧时，圆心在它的左方，所以净力应水平向左，对应箭头 B。
